 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Nebraska volleyball (23-0, 12-0) remained on the road for a Saturday afternoon showdown with the Michigan State Spartans (17-4, 7-4) . The Huskers were coming off a four-set victory over Michigan on Friday night.
 Nebraska got the win in four (21-25, 25-19, 25-17, 25-12) after the Spartans topped the Huskers in set one, capitalizing on early errors. Nebraska bounced back in the next three sets, eventually taking control of the match and pulling out its 23rd win.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Huskers hit 52-of-106 on the night. Michigan State finished 38-of-107. Nebraska, however, finished 30 total errors, 16 from attacks, 12 from serves and two from blocks. The Spartans suffered 36 total errors, 28 from attacks, seven in serves and one in blocks.
 Andi Jackson and Harper Murray lead Nebraska's offense, each pitching in 12 kills. Jackson hit 12-of-25 and posted six blocks. Murray finished 12-of-34. Manaia Ogbechie delivered a sharp 11-of-14 outing offensively and strung up a match-high eight blocks.
 Ryan Hunter hit a perfect 7-of-7 in the win. Skyler Pierce also finished perfect, going 3-of-3. Teraya Sigler finished 5-of-14 and earned seven digs. Bergen Reilly coordinated a massive night, totaling 45 set assists, six blocks, five digs and three service aces. Olivia Mauch picked up a match-high 12 digs.
 Nebraska now travels to the Pacific Northwest for its next batch of matches. The Huskers start their journey up in Oregon for a Saturday night after-dark clash. The first serve is set for 9 p.m. CT.
